```{r}
# Set data directory
data_dir <- "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/GSE284075"

# List files
gex_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "filtered_feature_bc_matrix\\.h5$", full.names = TRUE)
contig_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "filtered_contig_annotations\\.csv\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)

# Helper to extract sample ID
get_sample_id <- function(x) {
  str_extract(basename(x), "^GSM\\d+_PT\\d+_[^_]+")
}

# Create mapping
file_map <- tibble(
  gex = gex_files,
  contig = contig_files,
  sample = sapply(gex_files, get_sample_id)
)

canc_disc.list <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(file_map))) {
  sample_id <- file_map$sample[i]
  gex_file <- file_map$gex[i]
  contig_file <- file_map$contig[i]

  message("Processing: ", sample_id)

  tmp <- Read10X_h5(gex_file)
  tmp2 <- tmp$`Gene Expression`
  ## 1. Read GEX into Seurat
  tmp2 <- update_gene_names_sparse(tmp2)
  so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = tmp2, project = sample_id, min.cells = 3, min.features = 300)

  ## 2. Read and filter contigs
  contigs <- fread(contig_file)

  ## 3. Wrap in list for scRepertoire
  contig_list <- list(contigs)

  ## 4. Combine TCR
  combined.TCR <- combineTCR(
    contig_list,
    samples = c(""),
    removeNA = FALSE,
    removeMulti = FALSE,
    filterMulti = TRUE
  )
  
  ## 5. Clean barcodes
  combined.TCR[[1]][["barcode"]] <- sub("^_", "", combined.TCR[[1]][["barcode"]])  # just remove leading underscore

  colnames(so) <- sub("^_", "", colnames(so))  # just remove leading underscore

  ## 6. Combine TCR with expression
  so <- combineExpression(
    combined.TCR,
    so,
    cloneCall = "gene",
    group.by = "sample",
    proportion = TRUE
  )
  
  ## 7. Store result
  canc_disc.list[[sample_id]] <- so
}

canc_disc.list <- lapply(canc_disc.list, function(x) {
  # remove sample prefix up to the last underscore, then remove trailing -digits
  x@meta.data$barcode <- colnames(x)
  return(x)
})

canc_disc.list <- lapply(canc_disc.list, function(x) {
  # remove sample prefix up to the last underscore, then remove trailing -digits
  x@meta.data$barcode <- sub("-.*", "", x@meta.data$barcode)
  return(x)
})

saveRDS(canc_disc.list, file = "~/hpchome/canc_disc.list.rds")

```
